Name: All Staff
Purpose: Top of a three-deep chain, so membership has to resolve transitively rather than one level down

Name: Engineering
Purpose: Second level of the chain, and a department with a team beneath it

Name: Team Platform
Purpose: Third level; membership here must resolve all the way up to All Staff

Name: Sales
Purpose: A sibling department with no children, containing a disabled user and a locked one

Name: Finance
Purpose: The only group the payroll application is assigned to, with exactly one member

Name: Leadership
Purpose: Outside the staff chain, with a single member

Name: Contractors
Purpose: Outside the staff chain. Its members are the contractors population, but the contractor attribute disagrees: some members are flagged false, and a partner flagged true is not in it

Name: Partners
Purpose: Scoped to a population, so a user outside it cannot be added however hard a script tries

Name: Dynamic Staff
Purpose: Membership PingOne maintains from a filter, which cannot be edited by hand and is empty until it evaluates

Name: Dynamic Nobody
Purpose: A filter that is valid and matches nobody, which looks identical to a broken filter in every report

Name: Offboarding Hold
Purpose: Deliberately empty, because an empty group and a failed query look identical
